text: We're setting up a new location: the Indirect Material Inspection station.
One workbench, one material cart, one magnifying lamp, and seats for one or two operators.
The bench is fifteen hundred fifty millimeters long, seven hundred fifty deep, and twenty-two hundred tall.
asr: The bench is 1550 mm long, 750 deep, and 2200 tall.

text: A blue, powder-coated steel frame carries a twenty-five millimeter white laminate top.
On the left, a stainless steel cart brings material in, and takes it back when the check is done.
The L E D panel reaches seven hundred millimeters forward, on angled brackets, lighting the whole worktop.
asr: The LED panel reaches 700mm forward on angled brackets lighting the whole worktop.

text: At the left rear corner, an E S D magnifying lamp swings over the center, for close visual checks.
asr: At the left rear corner, an ESD magnifying lamp swings over the center, for close visual checks.

text: Above, a full-length cabinet, with one wide door and a key lock, keeps tools and samples secure.
Along the back, a four-outlet power rail.
Two blue E S D chairs, with foot rings and casters, seat one or two operators.
asr: Two blue ESD chairs, with foot rings and casters, seat one or two operators.

text: One location. Everything the inspector needs, within reach.
